body: (Cont. News of ISLAMICFIN): EPS for the period ended September 30, 2026, fell to BDT (2.61), compared to BDT (1.94) for the same period of last year. This decline in EPS was primarily driven by the recognition of provisions against classified investment accounts and the reversal of income related to the settlement of defaulted accounts. Income was further impacted by reduction in the overall investment portfolio. (cont.2)
